method: Package metadata inspection, npm registry audit, lifecycle scripts analysis, license and NOTICE evaluation, vulnerability and supply chain triage. No unreviewed code installed or executed in production/runtime.

artifacts.name: hyperframes
findings: Vendors GreenSock GSAP (dist/vendor/npm/gsap@3.15.0/dist/gsap.min.js, CustomEase.min.js, MotionPathPlugin.min.js). GSAP is subject to commercial license restrictions under GreenSock terms and is not freely redistributable under Apache-2.0.

Contains direct integration with third-party cloud services: Google GenAI (@google/genai@1.52.0), ONNX Runtime, HeyGen billing (dist/billing-*.js), HeyGen authentication (dist/auth-*.js), telemetry (dist/telemetry-*.js), auto-update checks (dist/autoUpdate-*.js), and cloud TTS/transcribe endpoints.
Depends on giget and undici for remote template downloading and network fetches, violating zero-egress offline renderer requirements.
Transitively depends on puppeteer which executes node install.mjs postinstall script.
artifacts.usage_policy: STRICTLY BLOCKED from production, staging, and container runtimes. Never install in root workspace.

artifacts.name: @hyperframes/engine

install_scripts.detail: Direct dependency on puppeteer@~25.11.0 triggers 'node install.mjs' postinstall script which downloads unpinned Chromium binary over internet.

findings: Unpinned binary download during installation violates reproducible builds and zero-egress security policy.
Engine hardcodes Chrome startup parameters and attempts host memory introspection (dist/services/wslHost.js, dist/services/chromeHostCeiling.js).
artifacts.usage_policy: BLOCKED. Do not install. In P2-01, engine rendering will use internal Chromium frame capture and direct CDP/Puppeteer-core integration.

artifacts.name: @hyperframes/core
findings: Contains core time-attribute parsing, scene timeline scheduling, linkedom DOM parsing, wawoff2, and CSS tree evaluation.
Contains adapter stubs for GSAP (dist/adapters/gsap.js) and WebGPU fragment shaders (dist/vfx/*.frag.js).
Does not contain postinstall scripts or HeyGen cloud billing/telemetry hooks.
artifacts.usage_policy: Allowed for evaluation in P2-01 spike within a network-isolated, sandboxed container only after line-by-line source audit. Must be installed with --ignore-scripts. If GSAP is required by its runtime, it must be replaced by native WAAPI or linear CSS transforms.

artifacts.name: puppeteer
findings: Automatically downloads Chromium binary from Google CDN during npm install. Violates isolated build policy.
artifacts.usage_policy: STRICTLY BLOCKED. Never add 'puppeteer' to package.json.

artifacts.name: puppeteer-core
findings: Lightweight CDP wrapper without browser bundle or install scripts. Requires explicitly provided executablePath or wsEndpoint.
Fully compatible with sandboxed system-installed Chromium.
artifacts.usage_policy: ALLOWED as primary browser automation driver for Chromium headless frame capture.

artifacts.name: playwright-core
findings: Alternative CDP and browser protocol wrapper. Zero lifecycle scripts, no automatic downloads.
artifacts.usage_policy: ALLOWED as viable challenger / fallback automation driver.

artifacts.name: chromium_headless_binary

security_configuration.sandbox_mode: ENFORCED (User namespace sandbox, no-sandbox strictly prohibited)

artifacts.usage_policy: Must be pre-installed in container base image, never fetched at runtime. Sandboxing is non-negotiable.

artifacts.name: ffmpeg

gpl_libx264.distribution_risk: Acceptable for private backend SaaS execution; triggers GPL copyleft source-offer obligations if container/binary is distributed externally.

security_hardening: -protocol_whitelist 'file,pipe' is mandatory to prevent SSRF and local file leak exploits.
Argv array subprocess execution only (no shell command string concatenation).
Resource bounded by cgroup CPU/memory/time limits.
artifacts.usage_policy: ALLOWED for internal video/audio probe, CFR normalization, and MP4 encoding. Non-free build is BLOCKED. Native AAC (-c:a aac) is mandatory.

artifacts.name: fonts_vietnamese

artifacts.coverage: Complete Vietnamese Latin diacritics (NFC/NFD), currency symbol ₫ (U+20AB)
Complete Vietnamese Unicode coverage, robust diacritics placement
Full Vietnamese diacritics and numeral support

storage_and_loading_policy.rendering_check: Must await document.fonts.ready prior to frame capture
